## Item 5 — Archive label preservation + delete-confirm that steers to Archive (resolves deferred Item 23)

- **Status:** PLANNED — booked 2026-07-18, **grilled 2026-07-22 (Opus session).** **Model: Sonnet, low–medium effort** (name-map fix + two count queries + an adaptive `PlayfulDialog`, following the existing dialog precedent). No schema/Room change (stays **v26**).
- **Request:** Alvin's original ask was a *confirm-on-archive* warning — copy draft *"This category has existing transactions and will become Uncategorized when archived."* — to give upfront informed consent before an archive degrades a category's historical labels. The grill **overturned the premise**: the code inspection found archiving *shouldn't* degrade anything (see below), which relocated the real footgun onto **Delete** and reshaped the item.
- **Grill finding (the load-bearing reframe):** archiving a category/account never touches its transactions — they keep pointing at it via `categoryId`/`accountId`. What each surface *shows* for those rows depends only on whether that screen's name-lookup map includes archived rows, and today it's **inconsistent**: **Records** ([TransactionsViewModel.kt:74-80](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/transactions/presentation/TransactionsViewModel.kt#L74)) and **Budgets** ([BudgetsViewModel.kt:108](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/budgets/presentation/BudgetsViewModel.kt#L108)) use `observeCategories()` (archived-**excluded**) → archived rows read "Uncategorized"/"Category", but **Analysis** ([AnalysisViewModel.kt:92](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/analysis/presentation/AnalysisViewModel.kt#L92)) uses `includeArchived = true` → keeps the real label. [CategoryDao.kt:31](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/categories/data/local/CategoryDao.kt#L31) explicitly *intends* preservation ("archived included so historical rows keep their label"), so Records/Budgets are the **oversight**, not Analysis. **Decision (Alvin): preserve the label everywhere** — archiving = hide-from-picker only, per platform convention (archive is the non-destructive twin of delete). This **resolves deferred [Item 23](deferred.md#item-23--archived-entity-label-fallback-in-records--budgets-️-deferred--needs-tester-feedback) toward preservation** (no more tester-feedback wait needed) — mark Item 23 done-by-this once shipped.
- **Change — Part A (label-preservation fix):**
  - [TransactionsViewModel.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/transactions/presentation/TransactionsViewModel.kt) — feed **both** the account-name map *and* the category-name map (the display-only maps at ~L79-80) from an archived-inclusive source (`observeCategories(includeArchived = true)` / `observeAccounts(includeArchived = true)`). The category/account **pickers** stay archived-excluded — only the label maps change.
  - [BudgetsViewModel.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/budgets/presentation/BudgetsViewModel.kt) — same, for its category-name map (~L108/L143).
  - Analysis: **no change** (already archived-inclusive).
  - Net effect: archiving a category/account never changes any historical label anywhere; **Delete** becomes the only action that degrades labels (a soft-deleted row drops out of `observeAll()` too, orphaning its rows to "Uncategorized"/"Account" everywhere incl. Analysis).
- **Change — Part B (adaptive delete-confirm on categories AND accounts):** add a `PlayfulDialog` gate to the currently-unguarded `Delete` menu action on both [CategoriesScreen.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/categories/presentation/CategoriesScreen.kt#L342) and [AccountsScreen.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/accounts/presentation/AccountsScreen.kt#L200) (both fire `viewModel.delete(id)` with no confirm today). Dialog is **always shown** (delete is permanent — soft-delete, no un-delete UI) and **adapts**:
  - *Has transactions* → shows the **exact count** and steers to Archive. Category copy: *"Delete '\<name>'? Used by N transactions. Deleting leaves them Uncategorized. Archive instead to keep their label."* Account copy: *"Delete '\<name>'? Used by N transactions (incl. transfers). Deleting removes it from your balance. Archive instead to keep everything."* Buttons: **[Archive instead]** (prominent/suggested — archives + dismisses) · **[Delete anyway]** (de-emphasized, `semantic.negative` red) · **[Cancel]**.
  - *Empty* → plain *"Delete '\<name>'? This can't be undone."* → **[Delete]** · **[Cancel]**.
  - New DAO counts: `TransactionDao.countByCategory(id)` (`categoryId = :id AND isDeleted = 0`) and `countByAccount(id)` (`(accountId = :id OR toAccountId = :id) AND isDeleted = 0` — transfers reference `toAccountId`, so the destination side counts). Surface via a small ViewModel field or a suspend check on the delete-tap; keep the number in `UiState`.
  - **Archive itself stays a frictionless one-tap** (reversible, non-destructive) — no dialog added there.
  - Budgets referencing a category are **not** enumerated in the copy (a budget on a deleted category still works, just relabels) — deliberately kept out to keep the copy clean.
- **Verify:** build-green + **on-device on a paired staging couple** ([test-account-credentials](../../..)): (1) archive a category/account that has transactions, confirm its old Records/Budgets rows keep the real label (not "Uncategorized"/"Account") and Analysis unchanged; (2) delete-confirm fires with the correct count on both a category and an account (transfer-destination account count includes the transfer); (3) "Archive instead" archives rather than deletes; (4) empty-entity delete shows the plain confirm. **Tier-1 tests required** for the two new DAO count queries (instrumented, or assert the query shape) — the count math is the correctness-critical bit; the dialog itself is verified by running (pure Composable).
- **Build-time flag (not solved here):** a non-creator deleting a **shared** (couple-owned) category/account may wedge sync the same way the ADR-0018 unshare-by-non-creator does (v1.6.5 Item 20 hides "Make personal" for the non-creator for exactly this reason). The `Delete` menu item is currently shown for all; check whether it needs the same creator-only guard while wiring the confirm. Pre-existing behavior — surface it, don't silently inherit it.

## Item 8 — "Playful Pop" visual identity redesign (multi-slice arc)

- **⚠️ HARD RULE (Alvin, 2026-07-20):** this is a **pure reskin — change the look only, NEVER remove anything.** Every existing figure, control, caption, row, and behavior must survive; only styling changes. If the 1e mockup omits an element the current screen has (e.g. the net-assets header figure), **recreate it in the new style, don't drop it.** This overrides "go accurately with the design" whenever the two conflict on an element's *presence* (not its appearance). See memory `feedback-playful-pop-pure-reskin-no-removal`.
- **Status:** ✅ **COMPLETE** — booked 2026-07-20, **GRILLED 2026-07-20** (design resolved, see "Grilled design" below). All 6 slices + the full Slice-6 rollout (6-CM, 6-PD, 6a–6j) shipped, plus a same-arc nav-bar-inset follow-up fix `DONE 44e7fd5` — see "Slice plan" below for the complete, closed list. **Model: Opus, high effort** — genuinely novel + cross-cutting: a new global shape/style axis the color-only theme system can't express today, spanning ~20 screens and interacting with the theme system (ADR-0014), the S9 palette-gating, and the navbar (ADR-0017/0026). No schema/Room change (pure UI/theme — stays **v26**; the icon-library migration keeps DB icon keys stable → no data migration).
- **Request (Alvin, 2026-07-20, via the `.design_handoff_1e_playful_pop/` bundle — `README.md` + `1e Playful Pop.html`, 4 hi-fi screens):** implement the "1e Playful Pop" direction — an expressive evolution of the current M3 look: **asymmetric "leaf" squircle corners, subtle rotations on hero elements, heart-tipped progress bars, hearts as accent glyphs** (legend bullets, date-header bullets, progress tips, Shared badges, split-bar knot), a restyled donut (57% hole, ~1.8° gaps), and a restyled bottom nav (pink-pill active slot, −4° rotated FAB). High-fidelity — colors, type sizes, radii, spacing are final in the HTML (exact inline values at a 360dp reference frame).
- **Resolved scope (Alvin, via `/book` clarifying questions 2026-07-20):**
  - **Integration = "Replace app identity."** The Playful Pop **shape language becomes the app's new default identity, applied globally** — *not* a selectable palette/style toggle. Replaces the global `IponShapes` M3 look.
  - **The 6 color palettes are RETAINED and the design ADAPTS to them.** The HTML's hardcoded blush `#FBE5EE` / deep-plum `#8B2A57` / pink-accent `#F48FB1` tokens must map onto **semantic `ColorScheme` roles** so that picking Rose / Mauve / Lavender / Peach / Sage / Mocha re-tints the entire Playful Pop look. **Nothing color-specific may be hardcoded** to the sample's blush-on-plum.
  - **Light mode required.** The sample is dark-only; every token needs a light-mode counterpart driven by the existing `isDark` flag. Both light + dark must ship.
  - Corollary: the shape/style language itself is **not** premium-gated (it's the default identity, free for everyone); only the existing color palettes keep their S9 gating (Rose/Peach free, rest premium) — unchanged.
- **NOT an IA change (confirmed):** the design's "Analysis · Records · ⊕ · Manage · More" nav already matches our existing model (reorderable pins + fixed center ⊕ Add + More, ADR-0017/0026) — it's one pin config illustrated, not a restructure. The handoff README's "nav structure unchanged" holds. Tab/screen content is unchanged throughout — reskin + layout refinement only. No new state (README §State Management): same data sources, percent chips derive from existing aggregates.
- **Grilled design (2026-07-20 — all forks resolved):**
  1. **Color sourcing = a derived `PlayfulColors` layer, NOT new raw palette tokens.** A `PlayfulColors` object exposed via `LocalPlayfulColors`, computed inside `IponTheme` from the *active* `ColorScheme` + `isDark`. One formula adapts all 6 palettes × light/dark; palettes stay the single source of truth; ADR-0014's live-preview/Apply flow is untouched (it already swaps the `ColorScheme`, the derived layer just recomputes). Rejected the ~24 hand-tuned per-palette raw constants (maintenance tax, easy to drift).
  2. **Mode-aware surface mapping** (the crux — `blush` is always the *lighter/softer* accent card, `deepPlum` always the *stronger/darker* one; the relationship holds in both modes):

     | Playful surface | Light source | Dark source |
     |---|---|---|
     | `accent`/`onAccent` | `primary`/`onPrimary` | `primary`/`onPrimary` |
     | `blush` (bright card) | `primaryContainer` | `lerp(primaryContainer, white, .85)` |
     | `onBlush` | `onPrimaryContainer` | `onPrimary` (dark ink ≈ `#4A1229`) |
     | `deepPlum` (strong card) | `primary` | `primaryContainer` |
     | `onDeepPlum` | `onPrimary` | `onPrimaryContainer` |
     | `glass` (rows) | `primary` @ .06–.08 | `primary` @ .06–.08 |
     | `background` gradient | subtle: `lerp(bg, primaryContainer, .10)` → `bg` | plum: `lerp(bg, primary, .12)` → `bg` |
  3. **Shapes = bespoke leaf-squircle helpers, global `IponShapes` stays conservative.** New `LeafShapes` in `core/ui/theme/` — `leafShape(big, small)` → `RoundedCornerShape(topStart=big, topEnd=small, bottomEnd=big, bottomStart=small)`, a `mirrored` variant, and an `index % 2` selector for alternating rows. Applied only to cards/rows/chips/badges/nav/FAB. Global `MaterialTheme.shapes` left sane so dialogs/sheets/text-fields don't get warped corners (keeps the incremental rollout safe — un-migrated screens keep working).
  4. **Rotations kept; only animations gated on reduced-motion.** Static tilts always on (identity; ≤1° on text-bearing cards, larger angles only on non-text decorative elements: FAB −4°, icon squircles ±4°, title heart −8°, nav-pill −4°). A `LocalReducedMotion` boolean (from `Settings.Global.ANIMATOR_DURATION_SCALE == 0`), baked in from Slice 1, makes the *animations* (chip radius/color morph ~200ms, progress-heart spring, FAB press scale/rotate) **snap** when reduced.
  5. **Semantic money colors = fixed, mode-aware `SemanticColors`** (negative/positive/income), the same across all 6 palettes (green = income regardless of theme), each with a light + dark value: negative dark `#FF97A8` / light `~#C62828`; positive & income dark use light greens (`#8FD8A8`) / light use `#2E7D4F`. Replaces today's scattered hardcoded `IncomeColor = #2E7D32` + `colorScheme.error` usages — migrated per-screen (un-migrated screens keep current colors until their slice). Negatives keep the app's existing `-₱x,xxx.xx` formatting.
  6. **Icons = actual Material Symbols Rounded (FILL 1) vector drawables** (not the webfont, not the older `Icons.Filled.*` drawing) for design accuracy — Alvin: "even the assets." The **entire category/account icon library migrates at once** ([IconRegistry.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/core/ui/icons/IconRegistry.kt), ~50 glyphs): swap the `ImageVector` *values* to Symbols vector drawables while keeping the string keys stable (`"food"`, `"rent"`…) → **no DB/schema change**. Any single glyph that can't be reproduced faithfully gets flagged, not silently substituted.
  7. **Partner colors** (Wifey `#F06292` / Hubby `#5B8DEF`) stay the existing `accent_color` attribution (ADR-0014) — unchanged.

## Item 3 — Profile & couple photo upload (pulled from Post-V1 Horizon #9) — concept resolved 2026-07-21, grilled + staged 2026-07-22

**Grill outcome (2026-07-22, Opus session):** the resolved concept's three legs are of very different weight and risk, so they're **staged**. Only **Leg 1 (motif avatars)** is booked for v1.6.7 (below). **Legs 2 + 3 are deferred to [v1.6.8](v1.6.8.md)**, each needing its own grill — Leg 2 (couple banner: derived vs. own toggle) and Leg 3 (premium couple-photo upload: Storage bucket + RLS + crop/cap + personal-vs-joint), whose gate can't go live until enforcement flips post-beta (ADR-0044) anyway.

### Leg 1 — motif avatars (FREE) — BOOKED for v1.6.7

- **Status:** PLANNED — grilled 2026-07-22. **Model: Sonnet, medium effort** — a mechanical pattern-follow of the `accent_color`/ADR-0014 synced-cosmetic-column path, no novel architecture. **Schema: one new `avatar_motif text` column on `users` → Room v26 → v27** + Supabase migration + DTO/entity/mapper (all mirroring `accent_color`).
- **Request:** Alvin's resolved concept — abstract/heart-motif avatar icons, free for everyone, as the app's first real avatar (today there is **no** avatar surface at all: identity is only accent *color* + display *name* + accent-colored `HeartBullet`s; CLAUDE.md's "accent color + initials" is aspirational, no initials circle exists). Grill decisions: **all-free catalog**, **fullest placement** (Profile + Couple identity card + Combined rows).
- **Model:** a motif = a **shape tinted by the user's existing `accent_color`** (no new color field), rendered as a **solid accent-filled leaf-squircle + white (`onAccent`) motif glyph** — the same recipe as the account/category icon squircles. Default motif = **Heart**; `avatar_motif = null` → Heart (dev phase, no backfill needed — [dev-phase-no-prod]).
- **Catalog:** 8 motifs, **all free** (no entitlement wiring in this leg — the column stores a string key, so premium-locked motifs are trivial to add later if desired): **Heart, Leaf, Bloom, Sparkle, Wave, Crescent, Gem, Sprout**. Rendered as accent-tintable vector paths via the `msRounded()` SVG→`ImageVector` plumbing from Item 8 Slice 2 ([MaterialSymbols.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/core/ui/icons/MaterialSymbols.kt)) — pick MS Rounded FILL1 glyphs matching those shapes, or bespoke `Path`s where a glyph reads poorly at avatar scale.
- **Change:**
  - **Schema/sync:** add `avatar_motif text` to `users` in [schema.sql](../../supabase/schema.sql) (beside `accent_color`, ~L65) + a Supabase migration; thread through [UserEntity.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/user/data/local/UserEntity.kt) / [UserDto.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/user/data/remote/UserDto.kt) / [UserMapper.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/user/data/UserMapper.kt) exactly as `avatarUrl`/`accentColor` are threaded (note `avatar_url` already exists dormant — **keep them separate**: `avatar_motif` = motif key for Leg 1, `avatar_url` = image URL reserved for Leg 3). **Bump Room v26 → v27** (destructive migration is fine — dev phase). Partner reads it via the same non-redacted same-couple `users_select` policy `accent_color` already uses (cosmetic, not redacted, D2). Users row pushes first (ADR-0013/0009), so it syncs ahead of everything.
  - **New component:** `MotifAvatar` in [core/ui](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/core/ui/) — takes `motifKey` + `accentHex` + size, draws the accent-filled `LeafShapes.IconSquircle` with the white motif glyph centered. A pure `motifPathFor(key)` / key→shape map + the null→Heart default are the unit-tested bits.
  - **Picker:** on [ProfileScreen.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/settings/presentation/ProfileScreen.kt), a new motif-grid row directly beneath the existing `AccentColorRow` (~L129), live-preview + save mirroring the accent flow ([ProfileViewModel.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/settings/presentation/ProfileViewModel.kt)); render the user's current `MotifAvatar` in the Profile header.
  - **Placement — Couple identity card:** show both partners' `MotifAvatar`s on the paired "You're paired!" card in [CoupleOverviewBody.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/couple/presentation/CoupleOverviewBody.kt) `PairedContent`.
  - **Placement — Combined rows:** replace the per-partner accent `HeartBullet` in [CombinedScreen.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/couple/presentation/CombinedScreen.kt) with `MotifAvatar` (re-touches Item 8 Slice 4). Requires threading each member's motif key — add `avatarMotif` alongside `accentColor` on the couple-member model (`MemberSpend` / `CombinedUiState`, and the `ObserveCoupleMembersUseCase` DTO it derives from).
  - **Out of scope (deliberate):** onboarding (accent is picked there per ADR-0014, but motif defaults to Heart and is set in Profile — not adding a picker there), Notes "From \<partner>" attribution, Settings-hub header.
- **Verify:** build-green + **on-device on a paired staging couple** ([test-account-credentials](../../..)): pick each of the 8 motifs on Profile and confirm the header avatar updates live + persists; confirm the avatar re-tints correctly across ≥2 palettes and light/dark (proving it derives from `accent_color`, not hardcoded); confirm both partners' avatars render on the Couple identity card and in Combined rows (partner's motif syncs in); confirm a fresh account with `avatar_motif = null` shows the Heart default. **Tier-1 test** the `motifPathFor`/key→shape map + null→Heart default (pure) and the `UserMapper` round-trip for the new column; the Composables are verified by running.
